server.description: Hostname or IP address of the Mandos server to connect to.

client_port.description: Port on which the Mandos server listens for client connections.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from the Mandos server.

max_retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed key retrieval before giving up.

reboot_delay.description: Seconds to wait after successfully retrieving decryption keys before rebooting.

keydir.description: Directory where retrieved keys and state are stored persistently.

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., decrypted keys before moving to keydir).

loglevel.description: Verbosity level for logging; one of: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency.

logfile.description: Where to send logs: 'syslog', 'stderr', or a file path (e.g., '/var/log/mandos.log').

gnupghome.description: GnuPG home directory containing trusted keyrings for verification.

gpg_keys.description: List of GPG key fingerprints (as hex strings) to trust when verifying encrypted key files.

verify_signatures.description: Whether to require and verify GPG signatures on key files. Disable only for testing.

trusted_fingerprints.description: List of key fingerprints (for legacy compatibility; prefer gpg-keys).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for network communication with the Mandos server.

bind_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to bind to (leave empty to use all interfaces).

allowed_networks.description: List of client IP networks allowed to connect to the Mandos server (CIDR notation).

mdns_enable.description: Enable multicast DNS (mDNS) to discover Mandos servers on the local network.

mdns_service_name.description: mDNS service name used for service discovery (usually do not change).

journal_socket.description: Path to the systemd journal socket (used only if systemd logging is configured).
